display.label: Azure Storage Container
display.description: Azure Storage Blob Container for organizing unstructured binary, file, or document data with optional blob object provisioning

resource.key_description: The unique name for the Azure Storage Container. Serves as the map key.

sections.label: Basic Configuration
sections.description: Container name, target Storage Account, and public access level.

fields.label: Container Name
fields.description: The name of the Storage Container. Must be 3-63 lowercase alphanumeric characters and hyphens.

validation.pattern_error: Container name must be between 3 and 63 characters, start and end with an alphanumeric character, and contain only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.

fields.label: Storage Account
fields.description: The Azure Storage Account where this Container should be created.

fields.label: Access Level
fields.description: The public access level configured for this Container.

options.label: Blob (Anonymous read access for blobs only)
Container (Anonymous read access for container and blobs)

sections.label: Security & Encryption
sections.description: Encryption scope settings and custom metadata.

fields.label: Default Encryption Scope
fields.description: The default encryption scope to use for blobs uploaded to this container.

fields.label: Enable Encryption Scope Override
fields.description: Whether blob-level encryption scope overrides are enabled for blobs in this container.

fields.label: Metadata
fields.description: Custom key-value metadata pairs for this container.

sections.label: Initial Blobs (Optional)
sections.description: Initial storage blobs or files to provision inside this container.

fields.label: Storage Blobs
fields.description: List of blobs to create within the container.

fields.label: Blob Name
fields.description: The name of the storage blob (can include virtual directory prefixes, e.g. folder/file.txt).

fields.label: Blob Type
fields.description: The type of the storage blob.

fields.label: Content Type
fields.description: The MIME content type of the storage blob.

fields.label: Source Content (Inline)
fields.description: Inline text or data content for Block blobs.

fields.label: Source File Path
fields.description: Path to a local file to upload into this blob.

fields.label: Source URI
fields.description: The URI of an existing blob or file to copy content from.

fields.label: Access Tier
fields.description: The access tier of the blob.

fields.label: Content MD5
fields.description: MD5 hash of the blob content.

fields.label: Blob Metadata
fields.description: Key-value metadata pairs for this blob.
